schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A4 (Content Factory wave 18)

entries.vietlish: install an appointment for the visa office
entries.natural: schedule an appointment with the visa office
entries.sourcePattern: đặt lịch hẹn -> install/place a schedule; English uses schedule/book an appointment
entries.context: My cousin tried to install an appointment for the visa office before Tet.

entries.vietlish: raise a complaint to the bank app
entries.natural: file a complaint through the bank app
entries.sourcePattern: gửi khiếu nại -> raise/send complaint; English service collocation uses file a complaint
entries.context: After the double charge, she decided to raise a complaint to the bank app.

entries.vietlish: run a refund request
entries.natural: submit a refund request
entries.sourcePattern: chạy/gửi yêu cầu -> run request; English uses submit/file a request
entries.context: The customer asked us to run a refund request for the canceled class.

entries.vietlish: catch a delivery slot tonight
entries.natural: book a delivery slot tonight
entries.sourcePattern: bắt/đặt khung giờ -> catch a slot; English uses book/reserve a slot
entries.context: I opened the grocery app early to catch a delivery slot tonight.

entries.vietlish: open a warranty case for my laptop
entries.natural: start a warranty claim for my laptop
entries.sourcePattern: mở hồ sơ bảo hành -> open a case is possible, but warranty collocates with claim
entries.context: The keyboard failed, so I need to open a warranty case for my laptop.

entries.vietlish: close the insurance payment monthly
entries.natural: pay the insurance premium monthly
entries.sourcePattern: đóng bảo hiểm -> close insurance; English uses pay premiums
entries.context: My aunt uses auto-pay to close the insurance payment monthly.

entries.vietlish: eat a traffic fine online
entries.natural: pay a traffic fine online
entries.sourcePattern: đóng/nộp phạt -> eat/pay confusion from colloquial chịu phạt; English uses pay a fine
entries.context: He forgot the deadline and had to eat a traffic fine online.

entries.vietlish: make a hotel booking on the app
entries.natural: reserve a hotel room on the app
entries.sourcePattern: đặt phòng -> make booking is understandable; natural travel English often uses reserve/book a room
entries.context: We will make a hotel booking on the app after comparing prices.

entries.vietlish: give a presentation slide deck
entries.natural: give a presentation
entries.sourcePattern: thuyết trình + slide -> over-attaches slide deck to the verb phrase
entries.context: Tomorrow Mai has to give a presentation slide deck about recycling.

entries.vietlish: take a language certificate exam
entries.natural: sit for a language certificate exam
entries.sourcePattern: thi chứng chỉ -> take/sit for exam; this item targets formal exam collocation
entries.context: He plans to take a language certificate exam in December.

entries.vietlish: do a bank transfer for the deposit
entries.natural: make a bank transfer for the deposit
entries.sourcePattern: chuyển khoản -> do transfer; English collocates make/send a transfer
entries.context: Please do a bank transfer for the deposit before Friday.

entries.vietlish: solve the broken payment link
entries.natural: fix the broken payment link
entries.sourcePattern: sửa lỗi -> solve a link; English uses fix a broken link
entries.context: The admin team must solve the broken payment link before enrollment opens.

entries.vietlish: join a queue number at the clinic
entries.natural: take a queue number at the clinic
entries.sourcePattern: lấy số thứ tự -> join a number; English uses take/get a number
entries.context: At 7 a.m., patients can join a queue number at the clinic.

entries.vietlish: send a sick leave to HR
entries.natural: submit a sick leave request to HR
entries.sourcePattern: gửi đơn nghỉ bệnh -> send sick leave; English uses submit a leave request
entries.context: Lan had a fever, so she needed to send a sick leave to HR.

entries.vietlish: open a savings book online
entries.natural: open a savings account online
entries.sourcePattern: mở sổ tiết kiệm -> savings book; digital banking English usually uses savings account
entries.context: My father wants to open a savings book online for the higher rate.

entries.vietlish: make a parking ticket at the machine
entries.natural: pay for a parking ticket at the machine
entries.sourcePattern: làm/vé gửi xe -> make ticket; English uses pay for/get a ticket depending on context
entries.context: Visitors can make a parking ticket at the machine near the lobby.

entries.vietlish: receive a vaccination shot next week
entries.natural: get a vaccination shot next week
entries.sourcePattern: tiêm vắc-xin -> receive is formal; everyday English uses get a shot
entries.context: The clinic told my son he will receive a vaccination shot next week.

entries.vietlish: hold a meeting with the landlord
entries.natural: have a meeting with the landlord
entries.sourcePattern: họp/gặp -> hold meeting can mean organize; learner often means have/meet
entries.context: We need to hold a meeting with the landlord about the leak.

entries.vietlish: write an online form for the scholarship
entries.natural: fill out an online form for the scholarship
entries.sourcePattern: điền đơn -> write a form; English uses fill out a form
entries.context: Students must write an online form for the scholarship by Monday.

entries.vietlish: lift a support ticket
entries.natural: raise a support ticket
entries.sourcePattern: tạo/gửi ticket -> lift/raise confusion; English tech support uses raise/open a ticket
entries.context: If the camera fails again, lift a support ticket with IT.

entries.vietlish: make a password again
entries.natural: reset the password
entries.sourcePattern: đặt lại mật khẩu -> make again; English uses reset a password
entries.context: I forgot my login and had to make a password again.

entries.vietlish: open mobile data on the phone
entries.natural: turn on mobile data on the phone
entries.sourcePattern: mở dữ liệu di động -> open data; English uses turn on mobile data
entries.context: When the Wi-Fi stopped, I had to open mobile data on the phone.

entries.vietlish: close location sharing after the ride
entries.natural: turn off location sharing after the ride
entries.sourcePattern: tắt chia sẻ vị trí -> close sharing; English uses turn off/disable
entries.context: For privacy, she will close location sharing after the ride.

entries.vietlish: take a receipt from the app
entries.natural: download a receipt from the app
entries.sourcePattern: lấy hóa đơn -> take receipt; app context uses download/get a receipt
entries.context: The accountant asked me to take a receipt from the app.

entries.vietlish: build a study habit every night
entries.natural: develop a study habit every night
entries.sourcePattern: xây dựng thói quen -> build is possible, but develop/form is more natural for habit
entries.context: He is trying to build a study habit every night.

entries.vietlish: run a survey for the parents
entries.natural: conduct a survey of the parents
entries.sourcePattern: làm khảo sát -> run is possible; formal reporting often uses conduct a survey
entries.context: The school will run a survey for the parents this month.

entries.vietlish: make a room reservation by phone
entries.natural: reserve a room by phone
entries.sourcePattern: đặt phòng -> make reservation; natural concise travel English uses reserve/book
entries.context: My uncle prefers to make a room reservation by phone.

entries.vietlish: hit the monthly sales target
entries.natural: meet the monthly sales target
entries.sourcePattern: đạt chỉ tiêu -> hit is informal; workplace report target uses meet/reach
entries.context: Our branch hopes to hit the monthly sales target before the holiday.

entries.vietlish: drink a vitamin supplement every morning
entries.natural: take a vitamin supplement every morning
entries.sourcePattern: uống vitamin -> drink vitamin; English uses take supplements
entries.context: My mother tells me to drink a vitamin supplement every morning.

entries.vietlish: share a feedback after the course
entries.natural: give feedback after the course
entries.sourcePattern: chia sẻ góp ý -> share feedback is possible in some contexts; target collocation is give feedback
entries.context: Students can share a feedback after the course ends.

entries.vietlish: repair my pronunciation mistake
entries.natural: correct my pronunciation mistake
entries.sourcePattern: sửa lỗi phát âm -> repair a mistake; English uses correct/fix a mistake
entries.context: The tutor helped repair my pronunciation mistake during practice.

entries.vietlish: take a taxi bill from the driver
entries.natural: get a taxi receipt from the driver
entries.sourcePattern: lấy hóa đơn -> take bill; English ride context uses get a receipt
entries.context: For reimbursement, I need to take a taxi bill from the driver.

entries.vietlish: submit a leave day for Friday
entries.natural: request a day off for Friday
entries.sourcePattern: xin nghỉ một ngày -> submit a leave day; English uses request a day off
entries.context: Because of the appointment, Nam will submit a leave day for Friday.

entries.vietlish: open a membership card at the gym
entries.natural: sign up for a gym membership
entries.sourcePattern: mở thẻ hội viên -> open a card; English uses sign up for membership
entries.context: She wants to open a membership card at the gym near work.

entries.vietlish: get the bus down at the market
entries.natural: get off the bus at the market
entries.sourcePattern: xuống xe buýt -> get the bus down; English phrasal verb is get off
entries.context: You should get the bus down at the market and walk two blocks.

entries.vietlish: turn a document to PDF
entries.natural: convert a document to PDF
entries.sourcePattern: chuyển sang PDF -> turn to PDF; English uses convert
entries.context: Before emailing it, turn a document to PDF.

entries.vietlish: make a backup for the photos
entries.natural: back up the photos
entries.sourcePattern: sao lưu -> make a backup; natural verb phrase is back up
entries.context: Please make a backup for the photos before changing phones.

entries.vietlish: take a replacement class on Saturday
entries.natural: attend a make-up class on Saturday
entries.sourcePattern: học bù -> replacement class; English course context uses make-up class
entries.context: The students will take a replacement class on Saturday morning.

entries.vietlish: set a reminder alarm for medicine
entries.natural: set a reminder to take medicine
entries.sourcePattern: đặt báo thức nhắc uống thuốc -> reminder alarm; English says set a reminder to do something
entries.context: I set a reminder alarm for medicine because I forget easily.

entries.vietlish: clear the invoice by bank transfer
entries.natural: settle the invoice by bank transfer
entries.sourcePattern: thanh toán hóa đơn -> clear invoice is finance-specific; general business uses settle/pay
entries.context: The company will clear the invoice by bank transfer tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: the bus goes very smooth today
entries.natural: the bus ride is very smooth today
entries.sourcePattern: xe chạy êm -> vehicle goes smooth; English describes the ride as smooth
entries.context: Because traffic is light, the bus goes very smooth today.

entries.vietlish: my phone is out of battery very fast
entries.natural: my phone battery drains very fast
entries.sourcePattern: hết pin -> out of battery; English often uses battery drains
entries.context: After the update, my phone is out of battery very fast.

entries.vietlish: the lesson has many new words
entries.natural: the lesson includes many new words
entries.sourcePattern: bài học có -> has; English can use includes/contains for lesson content
entries.context: The lesson has many new words about health insurance.

entries.vietlish: this app eats too much data
entries.natural: this app uses too much data
entries.sourcePattern: ăn dữ liệu -> eats data; English uses uses/consumes data
entries.context: When videos autoplay, this app eats too much data.

entries.vietlish: the road is repairing near my house
entries.natural: the road is being repaired near my house
entries.sourcePattern: đường đang sửa -> road is repairing; English needs passive
entries.context: The road is repairing near my house, so buses are slow.

entries.vietlish: the document lacks one signature
entries.natural: one signature is missing from the document
entries.sourcePattern: thiếu chữ ký -> lacks signature; natural English often uses missing
entries.context: The document lacks one signature, so the clerk returned it.

entries.vietlish: my company has policy work from home
entries.natural: my company has a work-from-home policy
entries.sourcePattern: có chính sách làm ở nhà -> has policy work from home; English uses compound noun phrase
entries.context: My company has policy work from home two days a week.

entries.vietlish: the elevator is spoiled again
entries.natural: the elevator is broken again
entries.sourcePattern: hỏng -> spoiled; English uses broken for machines
entries.context: The elevator is spoiled again, so we used the stairs.

entries.vietlish: the air in this room is stuffy too much
entries.natural: the air in this room is too stuffy
entries.sourcePattern: quá ngột ngạt -> too much after adjective; English puts too before adjective
entries.context: The air in this room is stuffy too much during meetings.

entries.vietlish: the rain is bigger now
entries.natural: the rain is heavier now
entries.sourcePattern: mưa lớn hơn -> rain bigger; English uses heavier
entries.context: We should wait because the rain is bigger now.

entries.vietlish: the medicine is hot for my stomach
entries.natural: the medicine upsets my stomach
entries.sourcePattern: nóng bụng -> hot stomach; English says upsets/irritates stomach
entries.context: I stopped because the medicine is hot for my stomach.

entries.vietlish: this shirt is not fit with me
entries.natural: this shirt does not fit me
entries.sourcePattern: không hợp/vừa với tôi -> not fit with me; English omits with
entries.context: This shirt is not fit with me, so I need a smaller size.

entries.vietlish: the price goes up strongly
entries.natural: the price rises sharply
entries.sourcePattern: tăng mạnh -> go up strongly; English collocates rise sharply
entries.context: Before the holiday, the price goes up strongly.

entries.vietlish: her English is more and more good
entries.natural: her English is getting better and better
entries.sourcePattern: ngày càng tốt -> more and more good; English uses better and better
entries.context: After six months, her English is more and more good.

entries.vietlish: the shop has promotion buy two get one
entries.natural: the shop has a buy-two-get-one promotion
entries.sourcePattern: có khuyến mãi mua hai tặng một -> calqued noun order
entries.context: This week the shop has promotion buy two get one.

entries.vietlish: my work is very pressure
entries.natural: my job is very stressful
entries.sourcePattern: áp lực -> pressure as noun; English uses stressful for the job
entries.context: At the end of quarter, my work is very pressure.

entries.vietlish: the teacher gives homework many
entries.natural: the teacher gives a lot of homework
entries.sourcePattern: cho bài tập nhiều -> many after noun; English uses a lot of before uncountable homework
entries.context: Before exams, the teacher gives homework many.

entries.vietlish: this street is easy flooding
entries.natural: this street floods easily
entries.sourcePattern: dễ ngập -> easy flooding; English uses verb + easily
entries.context: During heavy rain, this street is easy flooding.

entries.vietlish: the room has smell of paint
entries.natural: the room smells like paint
entries.sourcePattern: có mùi sơn -> has smell of; English often uses smells like
entries.context: After renovation, the room has smell of paint.

entries.vietlish: the battery is weak signal
entries.natural: the battery indicator is low
entries.sourcePattern: yếu/thấp -> weak signal transfer; English distinguishes battery level
entries.context: My laptop warned that the battery is weak signal.

entries.vietlish: the meeting is stretched too long
entries.natural: the meeting is dragging on too long
entries.sourcePattern: kéo dài -> stretched; English uses drag on for overlong meetings
entries.context: Everyone was tired because the meeting is stretched too long.

entries.vietlish: the class opens at seven
entries.natural: the class starts at seven
entries.sourcePattern: mở lớp/bắt đầu -> opens; English uses starts for a class session
entries.context: Because of the new schedule, the class opens at seven every Monday.

entries.vietlish: the clinic receives patients until five
entries.natural: the clinic sees patients until five
entries.sourcePattern: nhận bệnh -> receives patients; English clinic collocation uses sees patients
entries.context: The clinic receives patients until five on weekdays.

entries.vietlish: my bank card is swallowed by the ATM
entries.natural: the ATM kept my bank card
entries.sourcePattern: ATM nuốt thẻ -> swallowed; English customer-service phrasing often says kept/retained
entries.context: Yesterday my bank card is swallowed by the ATM.

entries.vietlish: the coffee shop is full table
entries.natural: all the tables at the coffee shop are full
entries.sourcePattern: hết bàn/có đầy bàn -> full table; English marks all tables
entries.context: At lunch time, the coffee shop is full table.

entries.vietlish: the internet is flickering tonight
entries.natural: the internet connection is unstable tonight
entries.sourcePattern: mạng chập chờn -> flickering; English uses unstable/intermittent
entries.context: I cannot join the call because the internet is flickering tonight.

entries.vietlish: this exercise is not out answer
entries.natural: this exercise has no answer key
entries.sourcePattern: không ra đáp án/không có đáp án -> out answer; English uses answer key
entries.context: For self-study, this exercise is not out answer.

entries.vietlish: the printer is eating paper
entries.natural: the printer is jamming
entries.sourcePattern: máy in ăn giấy -> eating paper; English uses jamming
entries.context: Again, the printer is eating paper before the deadline.

entries.vietlish: the bus is late thirty minutes
entries.natural: the bus is thirty minutes late
entries.sourcePattern: trễ ba mươi phút -> late thirty minutes; English places duration before late
entries.context: Because of the storm, the bus is late thirty minutes.

entries.vietlish: my eyes are sleepy after screen time
entries.natural: my eyes are tired after screen time
entries.sourcePattern: buồn ngủ/mỏi mắt -> sleepy eyes; English uses tired eyes
entries.context: My eyes are sleepy after screen time, so I need a break.

entries.vietlish: the app cannot enter
entries.natural: I cannot log in to the app
entries.sourcePattern: không vào được app -> app cannot enter; English names the user action log in
entries.context: Since this morning, the app cannot enter on my phone.

entries.vietlish: the bill jumps high in summer
entries.natural: the bill increases a lot in summer
entries.sourcePattern: hóa đơn nhảy cao -> jumps high; English uses increases a lot
entries.context: When we use air conditioning, the bill jumps high in summer.

entries.vietlish: the suitcase is over weight
entries.natural: the suitcase is overweight
entries.sourcePattern: quá cân -> over weight as two words; English adjective is overweight
entries.context: At the airport, the suitcase is over weight by two kilos.

entries.vietlish: the course runs too heavy
entries.natural: the course load is too heavy
entries.sourcePattern: chương trình nặng -> runs heavy; English uses course load
entries.context: For new learners, the course runs too heavy in the first month.

entries.vietlish: my face is allergy with seafood
entries.natural: I am allergic to seafood
entries.sourcePattern: dị ứng với -> allergy with; English uses allergic to
entries.context: My face is allergy with seafood, so I avoid shrimp.

entries.vietlish: I yesterday submitted the housing form
entries.natural: I submitted the housing form yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese time adverb can appear early; English usually places yesterday after verb phrase
entries.context: I yesterday submitted the housing form before the office closed.

entries.vietlish: She in the morning checks her blood sugar
entries.natural: She checks her blood sugar in the morning
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese time phrase fronting transferred into middle position
entries.context: She in the morning checks her blood sugar with a home device.

entries.vietlish: We with the landlord discussed the deposit
entries.natural: We discussed the deposit with the landlord
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese prepositional phrase position transferred before main verb
entries.context: We with the landlord discussed the deposit after viewing the apartment.

entries.vietlish: They for the refund waited two weeks
entries.natural: They waited two weeks for the refund
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese purpose phrase can precede duration; English keeps waited + duration + for
entries.context: They for the refund waited two weeks after canceling the ticket.

entries.vietlish: The clinic for children opens on Sunday
entries.natural: The children's clinic opens on Sunday
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese noun modifier after noun; English uses possessive/compound before noun
entries.context: The clinic for children opens on Sunday during flu season.

entries.vietlish: The card of membership expires tomorrow
entries.natural: The membership card expires tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese của phrase maps to of; English uses compound noun
entries.context: The card of membership expires tomorrow, so I must renew it.

entries.vietlish: A room meeting is available upstairs
entries.natural: A meeting room is available upstairs
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese noun order phòng họp -> room meeting; English compound is meeting room
entries.context: A room meeting is available upstairs for the workshop.

entries.vietlish: I very need the receipt today
entries.natural: I really need the receipt today
entries.sourcePattern: rất cần -> very need; English uses really with verbs
entries.context: I very need the receipt today for reimbursement.

entries.vietlish: He already sent for me the file
entries.natural: He has already sent me the file
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese dative phrase can follow preposition; English ditransitive order differs
entries.context: He already sent for me the file with the updated contract.

entries.vietlish: Please tell again the instructions
entries.natural: Please repeat the instructions
entries.sourcePattern: nói lại hướng dẫn -> tell again; English verb repeat carries again
entries.context: Please tell again the instructions because the room was noisy.

entries.vietlish: The teacher explained for us the rule
entries.natural: The teacher explained the rule to us
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích cho chúng tôi -> explain for us; English explain something to someone
entries.context: The teacher explained for us the rule about articles.

entries.vietlish: I bought for my mother a warm coat
entries.natural: I bought a warm coat for my mother
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese recipient phrase may come before object; English places object first with for
entries.context: I bought for my mother a warm coat before her trip.

entries.vietlish: The driver asked again my address
entries.natural: The driver asked for my address again
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi lại địa chỉ -> asked again address; English needs ask for + object
entries.context: The driver asked again my address when he reached the gate.

entries.vietlish: We at the counter paid the fee
entries.natural: We paid the fee at the counter
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese location phrase can appear before verb; English neutral order places it after object
entries.context: We at the counter paid the fee and received a receipt.

entries.vietlish: The system automatically for me saves drafts
entries.natural: The system automatically saves drafts for me
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese beneficiary phrase inserted early; English keeps verb-object together
entries.context: The system automatically for me saves drafts every minute.

entries.vietlish: My sister on the app booked a ride
entries.natural: My sister booked a ride on the app
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese location/tool phrase before verb; English places app phrase after object
entries.context: My sister on the app booked a ride to the airport.

entries.vietlish: The bank last month changed the fee
entries.natural: The bank changed the fee last month
entries.sourcePattern: Time phrase transferred before main verb; English neutral order after object
entries.context: The bank last month changed the fee for international transfers.

entries.vietlish: I still not receive the confirmation
entries.natural: I still have not received the confirmation
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese chưa/vẫn chưa -> still not + bare verb; English needs auxiliary perfect
entries.context: I still not receive the confirmation after paying online.

entries.vietlish: She only yesterday knew the result
entries.natural: She only found out the result yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese mới hôm qua biết -> only yesterday knew; English uses found out
entries.context: She only yesterday knew the result of the scholarship application.

entries.vietlish: The office next week will move
entries.natural: The office will move next week
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese time phrase between subject and modal; English keeps modal after subject
entries.context: The office next week will move to a larger building.

entries.vietlish: I have not enough documents
entries.natural: I do not have enough documents
entries.sourcePattern: không có đủ -> have not enough; English uses do-support for possession
entries.context: I have not enough documents for the visa appointment.

entries.vietlish: There is not any seat left
entries.natural: There are no seats left
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese singular existential transferred; English plural agreement with seats
entries.context: There is not any seat left on the evening bus.

entries.vietlish: The form online is confusing
entries.natural: The online form is confusing
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese adjective/modifier after noun; English modifier before noun
entries.context: The form online is confusing for first-time users.

entries.vietlish: A policy new starts in July
entries.natural: A new policy starts in July
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese adjective after noun; English adjective before noun
entries.context: A policy new starts in July for remote work.

entries.vietlish: The class English for nurses is full
entries.natural: The English class for nurses is full
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese class + subject order; English puts subject adjective before class
entries.context: The class English for nurses is full until August.

entries.vietlish: I need one ticket more
entries.natural: I need one more ticket
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese thêm after noun; English more before noun
entries.context: I need one ticket more for my younger brother.

entries.vietlish: The package small arrived first
entries.natural: The small package arrived first
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese adjective after noun; English adjective before noun
entries.context: The package small arrived first, but the large box is missing.

entries.vietlish: He works at home two days each week
entries.natural: He works from home two days each week
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese ở nhà -> at home; English remote-work phrase is from home
entries.context: He works at home two days each week under the new policy.

entries.vietlish: The doctor for me wrote a note
entries.natural: The doctor wrote me a note
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese cho tôi placement before verb phrase; English object order differs
entries.context: The doctor for me wrote a note for my employer.

entries.vietlish: We have meeting project every Monday
entries.natural: We have a project meeting every Monday
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese noun order họp dự án; English compound adjective before meeting
entries.context: We have meeting project every Monday after lunch.

entries.vietlish: The app Vietnamese version is easier
entries.natural: The Vietnamese version of the app is easier
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese app phiên bản tiếng Việt order; English requires version of
entries.context: The app Vietnamese version is easier for my parents.

entries.vietlish: I sent to HR the medical paper
entries.natural: I sent the medical certificate to HR
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese prepositional recipient before object; English sends object before recipient
entries.context: I sent to HR the medical paper after my appointment.

entries.vietlish: She has a bag very heavy
entries.natural: She has a very heavy bag
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese adjective phrase after noun; English adjective phrase before noun
entries.context: She has a bag very heavy for the train ride.

entries.vietlish: The receipt paper I lost yesterday
entries.natural: I lost the paper receipt yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese topic-fronting; English neutral sentence keeps object after verb
entries.context: The receipt paper I lost yesterday, so I downloaded another copy.

entries.vietlish: The fee service is included
entries.natural: The service fee is included
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese noun order phí dịch vụ; English compound is service fee
entries.context: The fee service is included in the final price.

entries.vietlish: I am actual living in Calgary
entries.natural: I am currently living in Calgary
entries.sourcePattern: actual resembles Vietnamese hiện tại/current; English actual means real
entries.context: I am actual living in Calgary while studying online.

entries.vietlish: The menu is very various
entries.natural: The menu is very varied
entries.sourcePattern: various is a determiner-like adjective; varied/diverse describes range
entries.context: The menu is very various, with dishes from many regions.

entries.vietlish: This evidence is very convinced
entries.natural: This evidence is very convincing
entries.sourcePattern: convinced describes a person; convincing describes evidence
entries.context: This evidence is very convinced for the insurance claim.

entries.vietlish: The staff was very enthusiastic to my problem
entries.natural: The staff was very helpful with my problem
entries.sourcePattern: enthusiastic maps from nhiệt tình; service English often uses helpful
entries.context: The staff was very enthusiastic to my problem at the counter.

entries.vietlish: The plan is not economic for students
entries.natural: The plan is not economical for students
entries.sourcePattern: economic relates to the economy; economical means cost-saving
entries.context: The plan is not economic for students who travel daily.

entries.vietlish: I will borrow you my charger
entries.natural: I will lend you my charger
entries.sourcePattern: borrow/lend direction error from Vietnamese mượn/cho mượn
entries.context: If your phone is low, I will borrow you my charger.

entries.vietlish: Can you borrow me your notes
entries.natural: Can you lend me your notes
entries.sourcePattern: borrow/lend direction error; speaker receives, so lend me
entries.context: Can you borrow me your notes before the exam?

entries.vietlish: The recipe is very sensible to salt
entries.natural: The recipe is very sensitive to salt
entries.sourcePattern: sensible means practical; sensitive means easily affected
entries.context: The recipe is very sensible to salt, so add a little at a time.

entries.vietlish: My schedule is flexible for overtime
entries.natural: My schedule allows overtime
entries.sourcePattern: flexible may be overused for availability; natural workplace English names availability
entries.context: My schedule is flexible for overtime during the product launch.

entries.vietlish: The lecture was very comprehensive for beginners
entries.natural: The lecture was very easy to understand for beginners
entries.sourcePattern: comprehensive means complete, not necessarily understandable
entries.context: The lecture was very comprehensive for beginners in the first week.

entries.vietlish: I assisted the workshop yesterday
entries.natural: I attended the workshop yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: assist means help; French-like/loan false friend for attend appears in learner English
entries.context: I assisted the workshop yesterday about workplace safety.

entries.vietlish: The room is convenient for thirty people
entries.natural: The room can accommodate thirty people
entries.sourcePattern: convenient means easy/useful, not capacity-suitable
entries.context: The room is convenient for thirty people if we add chairs.

entries.vietlish: This medicine is effective to headache
entries.natural: This medicine is effective for headaches
entries.sourcePattern: effective to is a preposition false friend; English uses effective for/against
entries.context: This medicine is effective to headache when I take it early.

entries.vietlish: The answer is relative to the context
entries.natural: The answer depends on the context
entries.sourcePattern: relative to is technical; learners may mean depends on
entries.context: The answer is relative to the context in this grammar question.

entries.vietlish: My boss is very sympathetic
entries.natural: My boss is very likable
entries.sourcePattern: sympathetic means showing sympathy; Vietnamese dễ thương may be overmapped
entries.context: My boss is very sympathetic and easy to talk to.

entries.vietlish: The restaurant is familiar with tourists
entries.natural: The restaurant is popular with tourists
entries.sourcePattern: familiar with means known to someone; popular with means liked by a group
entries.context: The restaurant is familiar with tourists because of its river view.

entries.vietlish: This solution is eventual
entries.natural: This solution is temporary
entries.sourcePattern: eventual means final after time, not possible/temporary; false friend from eventual/possible usage
entries.context: This solution is eventual until the technician arrives.

entries.vietlish: The course is adapted for nurses
entries.natural: The course is suitable for nurses
entries.sourcePattern: adapted means modified; suitable means appropriate
entries.context: The course is adapted for nurses who need medical English.

entries.vietlish: The signal is sensible to weather
entries.natural: The signal is sensitive to weather
entries.sourcePattern: sensible/sensitive confusion
entries.context: The signal is sensible to weather in the mountain area.

entries.vietlish: She is very confident with computers
entries.natural: She is very comfortable with computers
entries.sourcePattern: confident can fit ability; comfortable is natural for ease using tools
entries.context: She is very confident with computers after the training.

entries.vietlish: This app is actual for new users
entries.natural: This app is up to date for new users
entries.sourcePattern: actual does not mean current/up-to-date in English
entries.context: This app is actual for new users after the redesign.

entries.vietlish: The manager controlled my report
entries.natural: The manager checked my report
entries.sourcePattern: control can mean manage; Vietnamese kiểm tra maps to check, not control
entries.context: Before submission, the manager controlled my report.

entries.vietlish: I passed the pharmacy to buy medicine
entries.natural: I stopped by the pharmacy to buy medicine
entries.sourcePattern: pass by means go past; ghé qua maps to stop by
entries.context: On the way home, I passed the pharmacy to buy medicine.

entries.vietlish: The class is reserved for children under ten
entries.natural: The class is designed for children under ten
entries.sourcePattern: reserved means set aside; learner may mean designed/intended
entries.context: The class is reserved for children under ten who are new to English.

entries.vietlish: My colleague is very responsible to deadlines
entries.natural: My colleague is very reliable with deadlines
entries.sourcePattern: responsible to someone differs from reliable about deadlines
entries.context: My colleague is very responsible to deadlines on shared projects.

entries.vietlish: This city is animated at night
entries.natural: This city is lively at night
entries.sourcePattern: animated usually means film/movement; lively describes a place
entries.context: This city is animated at night during the festival.

entries.vietlish: The bank requires an original copy
entries.natural: The bank requires the original document
entries.sourcePattern: original copy is contradictory in English when original document is meant
entries.context: The bank requires an original copy of my passport.

entries.vietlish: The service is adequate for elderly users
entries.natural: The service is suitable for elderly users
entries.sourcePattern: adequate means barely enough; Vietnamese phù hợp maps better to suitable
entries.context: The service is adequate for elderly users who need larger text.

entries.vietlish: I am interested about the refund policy
entries.natural: I am interested in the refund policy
entries.sourcePattern: interested takes in, not about
entries.context: Before I book, I am interested about the refund policy.

entries.vietlish: The problem is consequent from the update
entries.natural: The problem results from the update
entries.sourcePattern: consequent is uncommon adjective; result from is natural
entries.context: The problem is consequent from the update released last night.

entries.vietlish: The certificate is valuable for two years
entries.natural: The certificate is valid for two years
entries.sourcePattern: valuable means worth money/important; valid means legally accepted
entries.context: The certificate is valuable for two years after the test date.

entries.vietlish: The teacher noticed us about the change
entries.natural: The teacher notified us about the change
entries.sourcePattern: notice as verb means observe; notify means inform
entries.context: The teacher noticed us about the change in classroom.

entries.vietlish: The contract will expire in next month
entries.natural: The contract will expire next month
entries.sourcePattern: in next month is a preposition false friend; English omits in before next month
entries.context: The contract will expire in next month, so we must renew it.

entries.vietlish: This chair is very comfort
entries.natural: This chair is very comfortable
entries.sourcePattern: comfort is noun/verb; comfortable is adjective
entries.context: This chair is very comfort for long online lessons.

entries.vietlish: The airport procedure is complicated to elders
entries.natural: The airport procedure is complicated for older adults
entries.sourcePattern: to elders is unnatural; for older adults is respectful and idiomatic
entries.context: The airport procedure is complicated to elders who travel alone.

entries.vietlish: I lost the appointment because I slept over time
entries.natural: I missed the appointment because I overslept
entries.sourcePattern: ngủ quá giờ -> sleep over time; English uses overslept
entries.context: I lost the appointment because I slept over time this morning.

entries.vietlish: Please keep place for my bag
entries.natural: Please save a place for my bag
entries.sourcePattern: giữ chỗ -> keep place; English uses save a place/seat
entries.context: Please keep place for my bag while I buy water.

entries.vietlish: He said small with the receptionist
entries.natural: He spoke quietly to the receptionist
entries.sourcePattern: nói nhỏ -> said small; English uses speak quietly
entries.context: He said small with the receptionist because the clinic was quiet.

entries.vietlish: I go first to the counter
entries.natural: I will go to the counter first
entries.sourcePattern: đi trước/đi trước tiên -> go first; English places first after destination or uses will
entries.context: I go first to the counter while you park the car.

entries.vietlish: The doctor lets me rest three days
entries.natural: The doctor told me to rest for three days
entries.sourcePattern: cho nghỉ -> lets rest; English medical advice uses told/advised
entries.context: The doctor lets me rest three days after the surgery.

entries.vietlish: The company cuts my lunch money
entries.natural: The company deducts money for lunch
entries.sourcePattern: trừ tiền ăn -> cuts money; English payroll uses deducts
entries.context: The company cuts my lunch money from my monthly pay.

entries.vietlish: I have a stomach wind after milk
entries.natural: I feel bloated after drinking milk
entries.sourcePattern: đầy hơi -> stomach wind; English says bloated/gassy
entries.context: I have a stomach wind after milk, so I avoid it before class.

entries.vietlish: She changed wind by moving to a new city
entries.natural: She got a change of scenery by moving to a new city
entries.sourcePattern: đổi gió -> change wind; English idiom is change of scenery
entries.context: After burnout, she changed wind by moving to a new city.

entries.vietlish: The lesson goes into my head slowly
entries.natural: I understand the lesson slowly
entries.sourcePattern: vào đầu -> go into head; English says understand/absorb
entries.context: The lesson goes into my head slowly when I study at night.

entries.vietlish: I hold the phone for you
entries.natural: I will stay on the phone for you
entries.sourcePattern: giữ máy -> hold phone; English phone phrase is stay on the line
entries.context: I hold the phone for you while the agent checks the booking.

entries.vietlish: We should take experience from this mistake
entries.natural: We should learn from this mistake
entries.sourcePattern: rút kinh nghiệm -> take/draw experience; English uses learn from
entries.context: We should take experience from this mistake before the next launch.

entries.vietlish: The store hangs price wrong
entries.natural: The store displayed the wrong price
entries.sourcePattern: treo giá -> hang price; English uses display/post a price
entries.context: The store hangs price wrong on the shelf label.

entries.vietlish: I was caught rain on the way home
entries.natural: I got caught in the rain on the way home
entries.sourcePattern: bị mắc mưa -> caught rain; English uses caught in the rain
entries.context: I was caught rain on the way home and missed the call.

entries.vietlish: Please eat less words in the report
entries.natural: Please use fewer words in the report
entries.sourcePattern: bớt chữ -> eat/less words; English uses fewer words/shorten
entries.context: Please eat less words in the report so it fits one page.

entries.vietlish: The bus eats the road slowly
entries.natural: The bus moves slowly along the road
entries.sourcePattern: ăn đường is not literal in English; movement uses moves/travels
entries.context: During rush hour, the bus eats the road slowly.

entries.vietlish: I ran the paper to many offices
entries.natural: I took the paperwork to many offices
entries.sourcePattern: chạy giấy tờ -> run paperwork; English says take/process paperwork
entries.context: Last week I ran the paper to many offices for the permit.

entries.vietlish: The price is soft for students
entries.natural: The price is affordable for students
entries.sourcePattern: giá mềm -> soft price; English uses affordable/reasonable
entries.context: The price is soft for students who register early.

entries.vietlish: He has a hot temper mouth
entries.natural: He speaks harshly when angry
entries.sourcePattern: nóng tính/nặng lời -> hot temper mouth; English separates temper and speech
entries.context: He has a hot temper mouth during stressful meetings.

entries.vietlish: My head is running numbers
entries.natural: Numbers are running through my head
entries.sourcePattern: đầu chạy số -> head runs numbers; English idiom reverses structure
entries.context: Before the budget meeting, my head is running numbers.

entries.vietlish: The file lies in my download folder
entries.natural: The file is in my download folder
entries.sourcePattern: nằm trong thư mục -> lies in folder; English simply says is in
entries.context: The file lies in my download folder after the browser saved it.

entries.vietlish: The shop kills price today
entries.natural: The shop is cutting prices today
entries.sourcePattern: giết giá/chém giá can vary; English sales phrase is cut prices
entries.context: For clearance, the shop kills price today on winter coats.

entries.vietlish: I go to ask road at the station
entries.natural: I will ask for directions at the station
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi đường -> ask road; English uses ask for directions
entries.context: If the map fails, I go to ask road at the station.

entries.vietlish: The cashier counts money lacking
entries.natural: The cashier gave me too little change
entries.sourcePattern: đếm thiếu tiền -> count money lacking; English names the change outcome
entries.context: The cashier counts money lacking, so I checked the receipt.

entries.vietlish: I drank the parking ticket
entries.natural: I paid the parking ticket
entries.sourcePattern: uống/ăn phạt is figurative in Vietnamese; English says pay a ticket
entries.context: Because I parked late, I drank the parking ticket online.

entries.vietlish: The child is hard eating vegetables
entries.natural: The child is picky about eating vegetables
entries.sourcePattern: khó ăn -> hard eating; English uses picky about food
entries.context: The child is hard eating vegetables at school lunch.

entries.vietlish: The room catches sun in the afternoon
entries.natural: The room gets afternoon sun
entries.sourcePattern: bắt nắng -> catches sun; English uses gets sun
entries.context: The room catches sun in the afternoon and becomes hot.

entries.vietlish: I broke money for the taxi
entries.natural: I broke a bill for the taxi
entries.sourcePattern: đổi tiền lẻ -> break money; English says break a bill
entries.context: I broke money for the taxi because the driver had no change.

entries.vietlish: She saved face for the team
entries.natural: She helped the team avoid embarrassment
entries.sourcePattern: giữ thể diện -> save face; idiom exists, but plain workplace English may prefer avoid embarrassment
entries.context: By explaining the error calmly, she saved face for the team.

entries.vietlish: The lesson opens my eyes about tax
entries.natural: The lesson helped me understand tax better
entries.sourcePattern: mở mắt -> open eyes; English idiom exists but may be too dramatic for routine learning
entries.context: The lesson opens my eyes about tax for part-time workers.

entries.vietlish: I put question to the teacher
entries.natural: I asked the teacher a question
entries.sourcePattern: đặt câu hỏi -> put/place question; English uses ask
entries.context: After class, I put question to the teacher about pronunciation.

entries.vietlish: The policy ties hands of managers
entries.natural: The policy limits what managers can do
entries.sourcePattern: trói tay -> tie hands; idiom exists but may be too informal for policy summary
entries.context: The policy ties hands of managers when schedules change.

entries.vietlish: The customer made noise at the counter
entries.natural: The customer complained loudly at the counter
entries.sourcePattern: làm ồn/làm um -> make noise; service context often means complain loudly
entries.context: The customer made noise at the counter about the refund.

entries.vietlish: I kept stomach empty for the blood test
entries.natural: I fasted for the blood test
entries.sourcePattern: nhịn ăn -> keep stomach empty; English medical term is fast
entries.context: I kept stomach empty for the blood test this morning.

entries.vietlish: The message fell into spam
entries.natural: The message went to spam
entries.sourcePattern: rơi vào thư rác -> fell into spam; English says went to spam
entries.context: The message fell into spam, so I missed the deadline.

entries.vietlish: He took heart to speak English
entries.natural: He found the courage to speak English
entries.sourcePattern: lấy can đảm -> take heart; English uses find courage/take heart differently
entries.context: At the meeting, he took heart to speak English with clients.

entries.vietlish: Give me your passport now
entries.natural: Could I see your passport, please?
entries.sourcePattern: Direct Vietnamese imperative can sound too abrupt in service English
entries.context: At the hotel desk, the clerk said, "Give me your passport now."

entries.vietlish: You must wait outside
entries.natural: Could you please wait outside?
entries.sourcePattern: Direct obligation sounds harsh when making a polite request
entries.context: The receptionist told the patient, "You must wait outside."

entries.vietlish: I want you to fix this immediately
entries.natural: Could you help me fix this as soon as possible?
entries.sourcePattern: Customer complaint transferred as command; English service requests soften demand
entries.context: In the support chat, I wrote, "I want you to fix this immediately."

entries.vietlish: Tell me your name again
entries.natural: Could you repeat your name, please?
entries.sourcePattern: Direct tell me can sound abrupt; repeat is the polite service verb
entries.context: On the phone, the agent said, "Tell me your name again."

entries.vietlish: This bill is your mistake
entries.natural: I think there may be a mistake on this bill
entries.sourcePattern: Direct blame can escalate; English customer service often frames the issue as a possible mistake
entries.context: At the counter, I said, "This bill is your mistake."

entries.vietlish: I demand a room change
entries.natural: Could I request a room change?
entries.sourcePattern: Demand is too forceful for a normal hotel request
entries.context: Because of the noise, the guest said, "I demand a room change."

entries.vietlish: Send me the contract today
entries.natural: Could you send me the contract today?
entries.sourcePattern: Bare imperative is abrupt in business email
entries.context: In an email to the supplier, Minh wrote, "Send me the contract today."

entries.vietlish: Explain me why the fee is high
entries.natural: Could you explain why the fee is high?
entries.sourcePattern: Explain me is grammar plus directness issue; polite question fits service context
entries.context: During the call, I asked, "Explain me why the fee is high."

entries.vietlish: I don't accept this answer
entries.natural: I'm not sure this answers my question
entries.sourcePattern: Direct rejection can sound confrontational; softened disagreement is safer
entries.context: In class feedback, a student wrote, "I don't accept this answer."

entries.vietlish: You forgot my appointment
entries.natural: It looks like my appointment may not be in the system
entries.sourcePattern: Direct blame vs neutral problem statement
entries.context: At reception, he said, "You forgot my appointment."

entries.vietlish: Give discount for me
entries.natural: Is there any discount available?
entries.sourcePattern: Commanding a discount sounds abrupt; English asks about availability
entries.context: At the gym, I asked, "Give discount for me."

entries.vietlish: Reply me soon
entries.natural: Please reply when you have a chance
entries.sourcePattern: Direct imperative plus reply me; polite email closing is better
entries.context: At the end of the email, she wrote, "Reply me soon."

entries.vietlish: You need to answer faster
entries.natural: Could you respond a little faster next time?
entries.sourcePattern: Direct criticism softened for workplace feedback
entries.context: After the project delay, the manager said, "You need to answer faster."

entries.vietlish: I require your help
entries.natural: Could you help me?
entries.sourcePattern: Require sounds legalistic/demanding in ordinary requests
entries.context: In a chat message, the new student wrote, "I require your help."

entries.vietlish: Don't talk while I explain
entries.natural: Please hold questions until I finish explaining
entries.sourcePattern: Negative command can sound sharp; classroom instruction can be specific and polite
entries.context: During training, the speaker said, "Don't talk while I explain."

entries.vietlish: The service here is too poor
entries.natural: I had a problem with the service here
entries.sourcePattern: Blunt evaluation can be replaced by specific issue framing
entries.context: In the review form, the customer wrote, "The service here is too poor."

entries.vietlish: I need your stamp here
entries.natural: Could you stamp this here, please?
entries.sourcePattern: Direct need statement can sound like an order at an office counter
entries.context: At the office, I said, "I need your stamp here."

entries.vietlish: Move your car now
entries.natural: Could you move your car, please?
entries.sourcePattern: Urgent imperative may be needed in danger, but normal parking request should be softened
entries.context: In the apartment lot, the neighbor said, "Move your car now."

entries.vietlish: You should check better
entries.natural: Could you double-check this?
entries.sourcePattern: You should can sound accusatory in service correction
entries.context: When the receipt was wrong, I said, "You should check better."

entries.vietlish: Let me know quick
entries.natural: Please let me know when you can
entries.sourcePattern: quick is abrupt/informal; polite business English uses when you can
entries.context: In a message to HR, I wrote, "Let me know quick."
